items.title: One-prime ramified reductive p-adic Galois representations with large image via relative deformation lifting
items.author: Anwesh Ray
items.difficulty_reason: The main construction requires finite-level relative obstruction classes, cyclotomic descent and finite rational obstruction control, integral toral weights and H1 cocycles, persistence of root vectors through compatible lifts, Chevalley commutator generation and a congruence-level open-image argument. Full author assumptions (split connected reductive group, center dimension at most one, odd cocharacter, odd Lie-good prime) and infinitude proof remain explicit. This is the independent global representation construction beyond the old specialization support proposition.

primary.label: complete original reductive representation main theorem with all hypotheses and large-image conclusion
